originalTitle: Iran looks to ramp up economic alliance with BRICS nations as war with U.S. drags on
summary: Iran’s central bank chief said Thursday that the country is set to join the BRICS New Development Bank.
content:
Iran is set to join the BRICS New Development Bank, the country's central bank chief said Thursday, as Tehran seeks to shore up its economic alliances almost six months into its war with the U.S. and Israel.

The BRICS alliance was set up in 2006 by founding members Brazil, Russia, India and China, with South Africa joining in 2010.

It has since expanded to include Iran, Egypt, Ethiopia, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Indonesia, with various other nations — including Belarus, Cuba and Nigeria — joining as partner countries.

Iranian state media reported Thursday that Abdolnasser Hemmati, governor of the Central Bank of Iran, had announced Iran would soon become a member of the BRICS bank. Hemmati is currently in India ahead of next month's BRICS summit, according to Iran's Tasnim News Agency.

"We are seeking to establish bilateral and trilateral monetary cooperation with member states," Hemmati said, according to Tasnim's report.

The NDB was established by Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa to help mobilize resources for infrastructure and sustainable development projects in emerging markets and developing countries.

Read more CNBC politics and policy coverage

A spokesperson for the NDB told CNBC the bank cannot confirm information regarding Iran's membership.

"NDB membership is open to members of the United Nations. The Bank's membership is open to borrowing and non-borrowing member countries," they said. "NDB recently welcomed Uzbekistan as its tenth member country, which officially joined the Bank on June 5, 2026."

Iran would have to move through the NDB's accession process before it can become an official member country. Current prospective members are Uruguay, Colombia, Ethiopia, Angola and Zimbabwe.

Joining the bank would make Iran eligible to seek financing for projects in areas such as transport, sanitation, digital infrastructure and urban development.

Long-standing sanctions on Iran have severely constrained its access to international capital, particularly from Western financial institutions and markets. The war with the U.S. and Israel has further ramped up the pressure on the Iranian economy, with inflation surging, growth plummeting and its currency in free fall.

U.S. President Donald Trump , who has previously labeled BRICS policies "anti-American," has threatened to slap 25% tariffs on goods imported to the U.S. from any country that directly or indirectly purchases goods or services from Iran.

CNBC reached out to the White House for comment on Iran joining the BRICS bank.

China is Iran's biggest trading partner, according to the World Bank's most recent data. In 2025, China bought more than 80% of Iran's shipped oil, according to Kpler data .

It is unclear whether that trading relationship has shifted since the U.S.-Iran war began.
chineseTitle: 随着与美国的战争拖延，伊朗寻求加强与金砖国家的经济联盟
chineseSummary: 伊朗央行行长周四表示，该国将加入金砖国家新开发银行。
chineseContent:
伊朗央行行长周四表示，伊朗将加入金砖国家新开发银行，在与美国和以色列交战近六个月后，德黑兰寻求加强其经济联盟。

金砖国家联盟于2006年由创始成员巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国成立，南非于2010年加入。

此后，该计划已扩大到包括伊朗、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国和印度尼西亚，其他国家——包括白俄罗斯、古巴和尼日利亚——也作为伙伴国家加入。

伊朗官方媒体周四报道称，伊朗中央银行行长阿卜杜勒纳赛尔·赫马蒂宣布伊朗将很快成为金砖国家银行的成员。据伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，赫马蒂目前正在印度，准备下个月的金砖国家峰会。

据塔斯尼姆报告称，赫马蒂表示：“我们正在寻求与成员国建立双边和三边货币合作。”

新开发银行由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非成立，旨在帮助为新兴市场和发展中国家的基础设施和可持续发展项目调动资源。

阅读更多 CNBC 政治和政策报道

新开发银行发言人告诉 CNBC，该银行无法确认有关伊朗成员身份的信息。

他们表示：“新开发银行的成员资格向联合国成员国开放。该银行的成员资格向借款和非借款成员国开放。” “新开发银行最近欢迎乌兹别克斯坦成为其第十个成员国，乌兹别克斯坦于 2026 年 6 月 5 日正式加入该行。”

伊朗必须通过新开发银行的加入程序才能成为正式成员国。目前的潜在成员包括乌拉圭、哥伦比亚、埃塞俄比亚、安哥拉和津巴布韦。

加入该银行将使伊朗有资格为交通、卫生、数字基础设施和城市发展等领域的项目寻求融资。

对伊朗的长期制裁严重限制了其获得国际资本的机会，特别是来自西方金融机构和市场的资本。美国和以色列的战争进一步加大了伊朗经济的压力，通胀飙升，经济增长大幅下滑，货币大幅贬值。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普此前曾将金砖国家的政策称为“反美”，他威胁要对任何直接或间接从伊朗购买商品或服务的国家进口到美国的商品征收25%的关税。

CNBC 联系白宫，请其就伊朗加入金砖国家银行一事发表评论。

根据世界银行的最新数据，中国是伊朗最大的贸易伙伴。 Kpler数据显示，2025年，中国购买了伊朗80%以上的石油运输量。

目前尚不清楚自美伊战争爆发以来这种贸易关系是否发生了变化。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
